body.text: Crypto News Bot — Daily Digest
Stablecoin market cap has slid to $302.5B, down over $10B from its May peak — the sharpest monthly decline since Terra's 2022 collapse, even as monthly transaction volume hit a record $1.79T.
Stablecoin News
GENIUS Act rulemaking deadline missed

US regulators missed the GENIUS Act's July 18 rulemaking deadline, leaving key stablecoin rules unfinished ahead of the law's January 2027 start; Treasury's FinCEN and OFAC issued a joint proposed rule on AML/sanctions compliance in the meantime.
Open USD consortium challenges USDT/USDC duopoly

A 140+ company consortium including Visa, Mastercard, Coinbase, and BlackRock launched Open USD, with Visa also rolling out a stablecoin platform for banks and fintechs to issue, store, and redeem digital dollars via the network.
Standard Chartered-backed HKD stablecoin nears launch
Anchorpoint, backed by Standard Chartered, is preparing to launch HKDAP, a Hong Kong dollar-pegged stablecoin, with a joint announcement expected before month-end.
JPYC gains first major corporate adoption in Japan

Logistics firm AZ-COM Maruwa Holdings plans to adopt the yen-denominated JPYC stablecoin for payments to roughly 2,300 business partners, marking Japan's first large-scale corporate stablecoin use case.
Hacking & Security Incidents
Triple-A treasury drained of $11.8M over 31 hours

Singapore stablecoin payments gateway Triple-A lost $11.8M in company treasury funds across seven chains after an attacker gained persistent access to its wallet management layer; customer funds were unaffected.
AFX Trade bridge exploit drains $24.15M on Arbitrum
Hackers obtained private keys from five validators to reach quorum and confirm a fraudulent transaction on an AFX-powered Arbitrum bridge, pushing July's total hack losses to roughly $97M.
Verus-Ethereum bridge hit for second time since May
The Verus-Ethereum bridge lost about $7.54M in its second exploit in three months, reinforcing cross-chain bridges as the industry's most persistent attack surface.
H1 2026 crypto hacks cross $1.1B, a record
Security firm Blockaid reports crypto hacks topped $1.1B in H1 2026, a record high even as median loss per incident fell, pointing to more frequent but smaller, more surgical attacks.
